d:
Someone mentioned the importance of discipline for his goals the other day, and he referenced me.
While I'm super honored by that, I don't think that I'm that special when it comes to short-term discipline. Some stuff is hard
However, I've found that LONG-TERM discipline (building a system that slowly works towards your goals) is quite effective and I try to include this for all of my goals.
Just some thoughts.
Have a wonderful day!
